name: What factors influence the cost of painting a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of painting a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen painting costs depend on the room's square footage, ceiling height, the extent of prep work, and whether cabinets and trim are included. Basic wall painting for a standard kitchen requires fewer labor hours, while projects involving heavy grease buildup, textured ceiling repairs, or multi-step cabinet spraying require more detailed work and specialized materials. High-moisture areas around sinks and ranges often need premium scrubbable paints or specific primers, which adds slightly to material costs but prevents premature peeling and staining.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on kitchen size, surface condition, drywall repair needs, paint quality, and whether the scope includes cabinets, trim, and ceilings.
